lemmas.statement: Z and X are each cloneable by CPTP maps; their union is not cloneable by any linear map

For two pure qubit rays with overlap squared p=|<a|b>|^2, a CPTP clone requires p^2=p (fidelity cannot decrease, so p <= p^2 and p^2<=p), hence p in {0,1}; a subset is cloneable iff pairwise equal or orthogonal; maximal cloneable subsets are the three antipodal pairs
